title: cs daily scratchpad - QBR prep & renewals
content:
TODAY (2026-05-15) - quick brain dump / running todo

Morning focus:
- QBR for Nimbus Health (10:30am PT) — deck final pass, call flows, risks + mitigation notes
- Renewal check: EmberRetail (renewal 2026-06-01) — confirm procurement timeline w/ billing
- Follow-ups: Support ticket #4569 (embedding mismatch) — Prod logs pulled? ask infra for trace id

Nimbus Health QBR prep (30 min final):
- Slides to update: 3 (SLOs/uptime, cost breakdown, roadmap alignment)
- Key metrics to highlight: 99.92% uptime last 90d, avg latency 210ms @ p95, tokens saved via caching ~18%
- Ask: permission to propose 20% reserved capacity (Dedicated) for critical workflows — prepare cost delta slide
- Risks: recent latency spike on 2026-04-27 (incident CS-2026-04-27-1) — short blurb + remediation steps implemented
- Action items before call:
  - Add customer quote from support thread (Sofia) — DONE? (S)
  - Confirm expected attendee list (Ravi) — CC: CTO, Platform lead, Prod mgr
  - Add POI for billing (finance contact) — include estimated monthly commit numbers (need from Alex in Billing)

EmberRetail renewal (deadline 2026-06-01):
- Current usage: ~1.2M tokens/month, heavy batch embedding usage overnight
- Proposed offer: 10% commit discount + 2-week free burst for sales demo
- Next steps:
  - Email contract draft to legal (Ravi) — target 2026-05-18
  - Run estimate scenario for 12-month vs 24-month commit (billing) — attach spreadsheet

Open support follow-ups:
- Ticket #4569 (embeddings mismatch) — customer reports vectors drifting after model swap on 2026-05-10. Notes:
  - Suspect model variant quantization differences. Need model config dump + exact model binary hash.
  - Assigned to Support: Jenna (SLA 72h) — escalate to Applied ML if no progress by 2026-05-18.
- Ticket #4599 (streaming disconnects) — intermittent, p95 latency spikes correlate w/ region us-west2. Engineering investigating (infra). Ask SRE for trace id and if recent kernel patch applied.

Meeting notes / things to say in QBR:
- "We've prioritized stability for your low-latency endpoints; since the rollout of prefix-KV caching, you're seeing ~18% cost reduction on inference calls."
- "If you lock in Dedicated capacity, we can commit to guaranteed throughput and a predictable pricing profile — details on slide 6."
- Be concise on incidents — what happened, what fixed, follow-up steps, and what we'll monitor in 30/60/90 days.

Personal to-dos (short):
- 9:00 — finalize slide 2 wording (value prop + metrics)
- 9:30 — sync w/ Sofia for customer quote insertion
- 10:00 — send pre-read to Nimbus attendees (attach deck + bullet TL;DR)
- 11:30 — update EmberRenewal spreadsheet with billing scenarios
- EOD — quick retro: what went well in QBR, what to improve (notes for playbook)

Loose thoughts / reminders:
- Remember to reference the "model variant fallback" capability when discussing graceful degradation — customer likes resiliency talk
- Ask legal about including a data residency clause for Nimbus (they asked during last meeting)
- Keep slides < 12, avoid too deep infra details unless asked

Unresolved questions / blockers:
- Billing estimate for Dedicated 4x GPUs — waiting on cost-per-GPU numbers from Finance (Alex)
- Embedding ticket needs model artifact + exact config (applied-ml)

Quick links I may need in call:
- Playbook: https://company.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/1245/Acct+Playbook+Q2
- Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4123
- Billing sheet: drive/folder/finance/q2-commits (ask Alex for link)

End of scratchpad. Keep short notes in here during calls (timestamped) — then move polished items to Confluence and deck repo.

-- Emma
